title: Road Trip Time Calculator
description: Plan drive time honestly: distance ÷ average speed plus your rest stops gives driving time, total trip time and exact arrival time.
howto: Enter the total distance and your realistic average speed (not the speed limit).
Add how many stops you will take and how long each lasts.
Enter your departure date and time.
Press Calculate for pure driving time, stop time, total time and arrival.

faqs.q: What average speed should I use?
faqs.a: Your realistic moving average including traffic and slower roads — usually 10–20% below the highway limit. The tool divides distance by this speed, so honesty here is what makes the arrival time right.
Number of stops × minutes per stop, added to driving time. Fuel, food and rest breaks all count.
Yes — departure is a full date and time, so arrival correctly rolls over to the next day (or later) with the date shown.
